'''Nova Orion Industries''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] research and development company founded by [[Jonas Nova]] and [[Garrick Orion]]. They were based on [[Nova Orion Station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] and built [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. They also were experimenting with the use of the [[midlithe crystal]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a disagreement led to a [[Nova Orion Crisis|rift]] between Nova and Orion, with each attempting to overturn the other.

==Behind the scenes==
Nova Orion Industries appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
